Callout.Name: Vandalism - Wind Farm
Callout.Message: Damage to turbines at a wind farm.
Callout.Advisory: Cables cut, security have nobody on camera.

Script.Line: Two cables cut, both on the blind side.
That is somebody who has been up here before.
The camera covers the entrance. It does not cover the back of the site.

Lines.Approach: Two cables cut and the camera does not cover that side of the site.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
